column2: This datasheet has been prepared by Solargis, under the contract to The World Bank Group. It is published as a partial output of the Global Photovoltaic Power Potential Study, analysing data from the Global Solar Atlas, World Bank Open Data and other public sources. It is a part of global ESMAP initiative on Renewable Energy Resource Mapping, to support the appropriate scale-up of solar power in the worldwide energy mix.

The methodology and details behind the data are discussed in the study, available at the Global Solar Atlas website (https://globalsolaratlas.info/global-pv-potential-study/). The study provides an aggregated and harmonized view on solar resource and the potential for development of utility-scale photovoltaic  power plants from the perspective of countries or regions. Based on consistent, high-resolution, and trusted data and replicable methodology; this study presents:
  • Ranking and comparison of countries and regions according to their solar and PV power potential
  • Approximate Levelized Cost of Electricity relevant to current PV projects
  • Cross-correlation with the socio-economic indicators, relevant to PV development	
  • Country factsheets with analytical data and relative position in the global context
The findings are relevant to policymakers, project developers, financial and academic sectors, as well as professionals and individuals interested in solar energy.
